# Mindspan

> Mindspan is a specialist neurology clinic focused on Alzheimer's disease, dementia, and cognitive decline. Board-certified neurologists see new patients within 2-3 weeks. Covered by Medicare and most major commercial plans. In-person clinics in Danvers, Massachusetts and the San Francisco Bay Area.

## Clinicians

- Dr. Naveen Reddy, MD - Clinical Director, implementation scientist focused on Alzheimer's diagnostics and anti-amyloid therapies, UCSD/UCSF-trained
- Dr. Timothy R. Kelliher, MD - Board-certified neurologist with 30+ years of experience, Mass General-affiliated, North Shore Boston (Danvers location)
- Dr. Noor Sachdev, MD - Board-certified neurology and vascular neurology, Columbia fellowship (Bay Area location)

## Conditions Treated

- Alzheimer's disease
- Mild cognitive impairment (MCI)
- Lewy body dementia
- Vascular dementia
- Frontotemporal dementia (FTD)
- Memory loss and cognitive decline
- Neuropathy and other neurological conditions evaluated as part of the cognitive workup

## Service Area

- In-person: Danvers, Massachusetts (greater Boston / North Shore) and the San Francisco Bay Area (San Jose / South Bay)

## Insurance

Mindspan accepts Medicare, Medicare Advantage, and most major commercial plans. Patients with qualifying dementia diagnoses on Original Medicare may also be eligible for the CMS GUIDE Model program, which Mindspan participates in.
